identification: Modern cast bronze figure of Atlas carrying a celestial globe (engraved constellations/sun), brown patina, on a rockwork bronze plinth set into a stepped round brown/grey marble base, about 33 cm. Signed in the casting on the plinth edge 'Aldo Vitaleh'. Aldo Vitaleh is a trade signature found on modern hot-cast decorative bronzes sold through import and online decor dealers (bronzhaus, Mayfair Hall, 1stdibs resellers), not a period European bronze.

viewing_check: Weigh it (solid bronze is heavy; spelter or resin is light) and try a magnet. Check height, the signature on the plinth, any foundry stamp, chips to the marble base, and whether the figure is loose on its base. Photograph the underside.
